name: Furie.ai Chat Widget
author: furieai

sections.description:
The Furie.ai Chat Widget adds an AI-powered live chat experience to your WordPress site.
Simply install, enter your Furie.ai Property ID, and the widget appears automatically.

The plugin includes a simple settings page under Settings → Furie.ai where you can enter your Property ID (default: 29).

External services

This plugin connects to the Furie.ai service to display the Furie.ai chat widget on your website.

When the plugin is active, it loads a small external JavaScript file from:
https://furie.ai/furie_dev.js

The script connects your site to the Furie.ai platform so that live chat sessions can be initiated and managed.

Data sent:
When a visitor interacts with the chat widget, their browser may send usage data such as IP address, browser type, and chat messages to the Furie.ai platform so that the chat session can be handled. No sensitive or personal information is sent automatically unless a visitor provides it through the chat.

Purpose:
The data is used solely to facilitate chat communication between the website visitor and the Furie.ai service.

Provider:
Furie.ai (https://furie.ai)

Terms and Privacy Policy:
– Terms of Service: https://furie.ai/terms.html
– Privacy Policy: https://furie.ai/privacy-policy.html

License

This plugin is distributed under the GPLv2 or later license.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the furie-ai-chat-widget folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings → Furie.ai to configure your Property ID.
  4. The Furie.ai chat widget will appear on your site automatically.
